title: Fix interval merging (adjacency)
prompt: merge(intervals) in intervals.py should merge overlapping AND touching intervals, using the Interval type from models.py. Touching means the end of one equals the start of the next (e.g. [1,3] and [3,5] merge into [1,5]). It currently treats touching intervals as separate, and it also assumes the input is already sorted. Fix both: sort by start, and merge when the next start is <= the current end.
